tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// dug bcos bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sbyor ba dang po 'dis/ nad gsar du zhugs ma thag tu sel bar nus kyi/ gzhan de tsam du mi zab/ sbyor ba gnyis pa yang*/ shu chung gso ba la sngags cung zad rtsub pas de tsam du gtsor mi mdzad/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa la sman gyi rnam grangs tsam yin gyi phyag len mang po mi mdzad/ ldum sbyor gtso che ba'i mthu'i sbyor ba 'di kho na 'jam pa dang*/ nad zug chog skyen pa dang*/ lus sor chud skyen pa la sogs pa yon tan mang po yod pas/ phyag len 'di kho na la mdzad do// 'di la sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba la nad ngos zin pa dang*/ a ru ra'i thang

gi gseb tu tsha la bag tsam btang*/ btang zhing*/ bsku mnye zhag bdun nas gsum tshun chod bya/ 'di nad gang yod kyang pho bar 'du ba chos nyid yin/ de nas dngos gzhi'i sman la/ mkhris pa gsum las/ rma bya'i mkhris pa rnyed na rab ste/ ma rims dang gcong gi shi ba ma yin pa drod ma yal ba la zer te de mi dgos/ rnyed kyang mi'i mkhris gang rnyed pa de/ pa dang*/ dom mkhris gnyis med thabs med do// ldum la yang*/ khyung sder dkar smug gnyis/ kyi rtsa ba/ dpa' bo dkar ser gnyis las/ dkar po rnyed na rab ste/ med na yang ser pos chog bong nga dkar dmar gnyis ka med thabs med/ dgos/ ldum bu re ral be skyes ma/ a sbyor theng re la gser mdog drug bdun re dgos/ ru ra rgya gar ma/ cu gang rgya gar ma/ dzā sbyor theng re la rdog ma gnyis gnyis tsam btang*/ ti/ gtsor mchin pa'i nad yin pas kha che gur zhol gzhal ba'i sbyor theng re re la zho re las mi nyung ba btang dgos/ gum bzang po mang du btang*/ tshwa'i gtso bo yin pas rgya tsha med thun gsum gsum thabs med do// tsan+dan dkar dmar gnyis te/ de rnams zhib par btags la thur mgo che ba re tho rangs kyi dus su gangs chus phul la btang*/ lus zungs shin tu zhan pa la chang la sman rta bya/ rjes la ka ra bu ram mur/ skyugs pa bsrung ba shin tu gces/ mal cha dron pos byibs la/ rngul chu shin tu 'byung bas legs par nang ma re re la lan gnyis gnyis gsum gsum tsam/ phyi/ zhog par chu bskol 'thung bu re re la rgya tsha nas sman 'ju bar byed pas/ tsam re btab la btung*/ cung zad bshal la mi sto/ drag tu bshal na sman thun gyi 'phro mi gcod/ bskyung*/ sman gtang ba'i dus kyi nang par gyi lto bcag la/ dgongs mo'i lto la nan tan bskyed/ nang par gyi sto nyi ma dros pa la zan dron dang lug sha rul sum ma yin pa'i tshod ma

lus zungs bskyed pa la med thabs med btang*/ chang gsar 'jam bag lus zungs bskyed pa la dgos/ tsam btung gi tshad pa'i grogs byed pas bag med mi btung ngo*// sman gtong ba'i dus su mi bzod pa'i na tsha byung yang*/ bcad na 'chi bas sman thun cung zad bskyung gi sman 'phro mi bcad/ sman nang re bzhin btang na lus zungs gis mi thub pas zhag gnyis gnyis zhag gsum gsum kyi nang par btang*/ sngo tshed dang ja mi nad byer nas 'gro 'thung pho ba'i me drod la gnod/ nya mi za lus ljid pas/ bshul chags kyi sha thams cad nad kyi grogs byed pas/ bsrung*/ ngal dub drag po ma yin pa'i cung sman btang nas yun ring po lon pa/ zad bskor ba bya lus dro bar byed pa yin/ zhing bcag mdor na sman shin tu bsil bas nad kyi zug bcag zas dang spyod lam shin tu dro bas lus kyi zungs bskyed par bya ste/ gos gsar pa drod can gon pa ni 'di'i lugs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag yin chu drod che ba gnyid phebs pa'i sar bsdad pa gal che'o/ no// 'di la dang po rta chang la sbyar nas dang po gnod pa bzhin 'dug kyang goms nas mi sto bas/ yang lus zungs bskyed pa la 'di gnyis sha chang*/ med thabs med/ na lugs grang ba ltar 'dug kyang rtags gzhan mi 'gul na/ sman de nyid las gzhan drod kyi sman/ mi btang*/ tshad pa cher rgyas pa ltar 'dug kyang zas skom de las sha dang chang gsar 'jam/ mi bcos lus rngul 'phro chad cing*/ sems kyi bya ba gang yang 'grub snyam pa byung ba dang*/ sman zug pa yin pas thun chung la yun ring ba btang*/ nad log na sman thun cher bya zhing spyod lam gzabs/ sman shin tu yun ring bar btang bas pho ba'i me drod nyams pa 'dra na/ skabs su se 'bru bzhi pa'i sman re mos bya zhing*/ 'gam phye lto stong la btang*/

sman de nyid kyi bshal ba mi skyon gyi/ bshal cis kyang bshal par 'dod na dur byid an tsam sman gyi gseb dru btang ba las/ gzhan mi bya'o// gtar ga dang me btsa' spang*/ myur na zla ba gcig de min yang zla ba gsum tshun chad kyis nad gsar rnying gang yin yang mi sel ba med do// lo gcig tshun chad spang bya'i zas rnams dang*/ lus sor chud nas gang yang mi sto snyam yang drag shul gyi las rta rgyug pa dang*/ bud med dang nyal ba dang*/ khur mi theg bzhin du khur ba dang*/ 'o dod 'bod pa dang*/ dung 'bud pa la sogs pa drag shul gyi las mtha' dag spang bar bya'o// dngos gzhi sman la/ don snying gang la babs gong gi pa'i sman gyi khrod du/ shas cher sbyar bar bya ste// ༈ /snying la babs pa'i rtags shes pa 'phro/ snying na/ dran pa mi gsal/ smra brjod bul/ snying mi dga'/ kha shugs 'byin/ gyen du blta ba dang*/ skom grang mi 'dod pa dang*/ shes pa mi gsal ba la sogs pa 'ong*/ de la khyad par du tsan+dan dkar dmar dang*/ li shi dang*/ dzā ti dang*/ a ga ru mang du sbyar la btang ngo*// glo ba la nad babs na glo lu/ sna 'gag nyin mo bde yang nub mo na/ sgal tshigs dang mjing rus na/ sgrog rus dang brang rus gzer zhing na/ glo ba rnag tu 'gro bas/ de la sman gyi gseb tu/ cu gang rgya gar ma mang du btang*/ star logs su/ bu dang dmar bu gsum gyi thang btang*/ glo lud pa'i grogs la rnag mang du 'ong*/ bse ru dang sman mu zi dang sbrang rtsi gsum logs su sbyar la btang ngo*// mchin pa la babs na/ mig mi gsal/ pho mchin khyad par du na mgo bo 'thoms shing mtshog ma na/ gyen du glo snying 'tshang*/ mar la pho ba non pa snyam byed pa la sogs pa 'ong bas/ kha che gur gum mang du btang gong gi khrod du/ brag zhun gyi khu ba la rta bya'o// mkhal ma la babs na/ rna bas mi thos/ rked pa na zhing mkhal 'bras gzer/

bshul sha na/ langs na lag pas sleb tshad na/ brla sul thams cad na/ smad mi bde/ chu sri/ lus sbrid bem bem byed pa la sogs pa 'ong*/ de la sman skyob mkhal ma zho sha dang*/ rgya mtsho gser gyi bye ma dang*/ sug sme la gong gi khrod du/ mang du btang ngo*// mtsher pa la babs na khog pa sbo/ rtse'u thung du zug nas na ba la sogs pa 'byung bas/ de la sman ka ko la dang*/ gla gor zho sha btang gong gi khrod du/ li shi srog pa rtsa'i kha 'dzin yin pas gal che'o// rtsa ba la babs na glo chung dang*/ skyigs bu 'ong*/ rtsa nang du 'khyug cing lus lci/ de la glo rtsa gnyis dang ru thung gnyis gtar na yang legs/ mjug tu nad thams cad pho ba la babs na na zhing glo bur du na na chu nang gi rdo grang mo lag pas ma reg pas dugs bya/ zas mi len/ mchu na na sman gyi gtso bo rnams dang*/ dur byed dang*/ a ru ra sbyar bas bshal byas/ yan lag la babs nas mi bde na/ gad phug nyi ma mi 'char ba'i khru gang gi 'og gi sa slo nga'i nang du bsros la/ dri chus bran pa ras kyis phur la dugs bya zhing nus tshad kyis bcag pa gal che'o// mthar nad thams cad phal cher byang*/ skabs su bag tsam mig mi bde ba byung na/ brag zhun btul ba'i khrod du bong nga dkar bo dang*/ a ru ra rgya gar ma cung zad btang ba'i ril bu ri bong gi ril ma tsam lto stong la zla ba gcig gi bar la btang bas byang bar 'gyur ro// nad sos nas yun ring du lon kyang skabs su mig mi gsal mi bde na/ na/ go snyod cung zad brngos te brdungs pa chu bskol la btab ste bsdus pa'i khu ba ngad yal ba dang*/ lto stong la nang ma gcig gnyis btang pas sel lo// gzhan yang ma gi ta bzhi sbyor zhes bya ba gla rtsi rang bzhin gyis zag pa dang*/ rin po che ma gi ta sha la yun ring lus pa'i mde'u/ sha ma gi ta byis pa btsas ma thag gis brun/ sman ma gi ta be las skyes pa'i ldum bu re re la/

de rnams zhib tu btags te ka ra dang sbyar la zho re'am/ gnyis sam/ gsum gyi tshad nang ma gnyis gsum btang*/ 'di la spyod lam bcag pa rem pa gal che/ 'dis mig mi gsal ba dang*/ sha mdog nag por song ba sel lo// mang yul skyid grong gi bzo mo rtsi rtsi dang*/ bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po nas brgyud pa/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas yi ger bkod pa'o// //yang dug glo bur ba la/ btsan dug gi rtags rkang lag sbrid/ lce mchu sbrid 'gag de la mi phyugs gang rung gi khrag dron mo phul phyed blud la chur bskyur/ de nas bul tog bya bal ma dang*/ bong nga dkar po tshwa rnying gsum sbyar la blud/ 'tsho bar nges pa yin no// //yang sha dug yin na mig mi gsal/ gre ba 'dzer/ bag re 'khru/ de la sngar bzhin bsdus la ldum bu re rel/ tsha la/ 'om bu/ lcags khu btang ngo*// 'bros pa khrag la bsdus nas nus pa sman gyis gsod pa ni gnad yin no// zab mo'i sman chus su gad/ bzhi bskums su kha bub nyal/ sha ba'i sha la dug byung na/ zas skom bcud can bsten/ dug sman gzhan yang*/ sha dug spyi la rtsa ba dang sngo thang btang*/ dgun bskol la cung zad grangs su gzhug cing lan 'ga' btang*/ brag skya'i bskol thang gis btsan dug rkyang pa sel/ brla la 'bu zhugs na/ sman chen sbrid thon tsam bsten no// byi tsher ba'i 'bras bu lcags snod du gri bskam bya/ lcam pa/ rgya tsha/ sdig srin/ rnon po bzhi sbyor ro// gnyan nad sel zhing rdo rje'i rigs so// 'di yan chod kyi dkyus mtshan rnams chos rje'i gsung ngo*// chos rje sa skya pa chen pos bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba dang*/ bzo mo rtsi rtsi la zhus/ bla ma chen po man ngag 'dis bsnyung gzhi las grol zhing*/ gzhan yang mang po bcos gsung*/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
